title: Steps Taken To Reduce Tax Avoidance In India
definition: Tax avoidance refers to the use of legal methods to minimize the amount of income tax owed, typically by exploiting loopholes, ambiguities, or gaps in domestic and international tax laws. India has instituted robust legislative, administrative, and international treaty mechanisms to counter aggressive tax planning and base erosion.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE GS Paper 3 (Indian Economy and issues relating to mobilization of resources, tax evasion, and international taxation). Frequently tested via concepts like GAAR, BEPS, POEM, and Double Tax Avoidance Agreements in both Prelims and Mains.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Steps Taken To Reduce Tax Avoidance In India.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Direct and Indirect Taxes in India
International Trade and Balance of Payments
